mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it indicates tight monetary conditions that may reduce corporate borrowing and investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive (>0%) in >40% of cases when FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals strong labor market conditions that may lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative in >30% of cases when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent growth in industrial production (INDPRO) at a rate exceeding 2% annually signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative in >40% of cases when INDPRO growth exceeds 2% annually.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) accelerates while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) remains below 4%, it signals strong economic fundamentals that may drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative in >30% of cases when GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.4 million units signals increased consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative in >35% of cases when HOUST > 1.4 million.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns remain positive in >40% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 100,000 jobs per month while retail sales (RSAFS) also increase, it signals strong economic activity that may drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative in >35% of cases when PAYEMS > 100,000 and RSAFS > 0%.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent growth in industrial production (INDPRO) at a rate exceeding 1.5% annually signals strong supply chain activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative in >40% of cases when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% annually.
